en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a European city street lined with ornate late‑19th‑century buildings. The image shows a straight, quiet street with a few pedestrians and a central streetlight hanging from a wire. On the left corner building a curved balcony bears the sign "HERZ JESU APOT" for Herz Jesu Apotheke (Sacred Heart pharmacy). At street level another sign reads "APOTHEKE". In the distance a building with a baroque onion‑shaped dome is visible. Printed text at the bottom left identifies the location as "GRAZ – NAGLERGASSE" and at the bottom right the publisher is noted as "ERIKA‑VERLAG – GRAZ. 551".
